verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents named user API tokens with expiration, and its MCP server supports per-client OAuth 2.1 approval or a personal API key for headless agents. That lets a user issue a distinct, time-limited credential for an agent, but no evidence shows these credentials can be limited to specific permissions or resources. Missing for 10: documented permission/scope restriction on tokens, per-resource or read-only token roles, OAuth scope selection for MCP clients, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
